planets.name: HD 5278 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of HD 5278 with a 14.3-day year, found in 2021.

text.card: HD 5278 b was found in 2021 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around HD 5278. Its orbit and size follow Sozzetti et al. 2021's fit, the archive's default.
